entires.openingCopy: I work in Ruby on Rails here, as well as Javascript/Jquery and Angular, HTML and SCSS. Although we have used Jenkins and Capistrano for most of my time at EnMasse, we recently made the switch to Docker. I developed the new TERA website, and wrote the interface for the in-game store for XBOX ONE and PLAYSTATION4. I also wrote the launcher menu for those console releases. I recently re-created our Account Management System and have developed a number of sign-up flows. We have a large audience in Europe and South America, so it's important to provide localized content on many of our sites. I work with the writing team to take care of this. I work on the web stores for each of our games, I wrote their interfaces, publish content to them and regularly create new mini-shops and pages for various promotions. I wrote the Kritika Online, Closers and AVA game launcher in Angular. I write html email templates for our Marketing team and transactional email templates for use in Yesmail. I also maintain all our game websites and publish content and updates to them.

interior.p: beta signup flow and regular universal sign-up flows

entires.openingCopy: This is a small team over in South Lake Union. The project load varies and I worked on .NET, PHP, and Django websites while I was there.

Located in Pioneer Square, Seasme Communications caters to Orthodontic and Dental practices, offering websites, marketing services, and HIPAA-compliant back-end systems. My dutes included the development and maintenance of responsive layout templates, along with many of the slideshows. The template sites and galleries were a mix of php, css, twitter bootstrap, jquery and javascript. I also managed changes and improvements to the global scripts and css files that governed these templated builds. I developed a dental temp site, a simple temporary site that could be generated by an on-boarding specialist, when new clients first signed up with Sesame. The on-boarding specialist would walk through a checklist with the client and a website could be up by the end of the phone call. I produced weekly builds of PSDS (a custom 'from-scratch' website) and SDS (a templated website build) products for new customers. I also aided the Designers and Producers to review site designs and ensure features in the design phase could be produced during development. As the Senior on the team, I was also responsible for general troubleshooting of markup, css and browser and OS compatibility issues.

.advancedmethod was a digital agency that specialized in video marketing, hotel websites and kiosk applications. I worked with Flash a lot in those days, making banner ads and hotel tours. I also wrote touchscreen applications and html emails along with rebuilding the Seattle Design Center website.
